title: Praja1 protects cells from DNA damage through direct DNA binding
authors: Kotaro Kawasaki; Toru Asahi; Wataru Onodera
one_liner_zh: 该文研究E3泛素连接酶Praja1通过无序区静电结合DNA并保护细胞免受DNA损伤，属于广义蛋白-DNA直接互作，但未涉及TF-DNA特异性结合、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，方法上以实验为主，仅部分相关。
abstract: Praja1 is known as an E3 ubiquitin ligase that regulates multiple functions through protein degradation. It acquired nuclear localization signal after gene duplication and although studies have shown some significant roles of nuclear Praja1, comprehensive analysis still lacks. In this study, we performed comparative proteomics and biochemical analyses to elucidate the functions of Praja1 in the nucleus. First, proteomics analysis applied to nuclear localization deficient Praja1 exhibited signs of DNA damage response fluctuation. Subsequent comet assay revealed Praja1 protecting cells from various DNA damage sources. Similarly, cells lacking Praja1 became more sensitive to DNA damage-induced cell death, while E. coli expressing Praja1 exhibited resistance to DNA damage. To further elucidate the molecular basis of DNA protection, gel shift assay showed direct binding of Praja1 to DNA through electrostatic interactions within its intrinsically disordered region. Further in vitro damaging assay suggested that Praja1 may induce structural changes that enhance DNA repair efficiency upon binding to DNA. Together, these results provide insights into the evolutionarily novel role of nuclear Praja1 in protecting against DNA damage.
abstract_zh: Praja1 作为一种E3泛素连接酶，通过蛋白质降解调控多种功能。它在基因复制后获得了核定位信号，尽管已有研究显示核内Praja1具有一些重要功能，但全面分析仍显不足。在本研究中，我们进行了比较蛋白质组学和生物化学分析，以阐明Praja1在细胞核中的功能。首先，针对核定位缺陷型Praja1的蛋白质组学分析显示DNA损伤反应波动的迹象。随后的彗星实验揭示，Praja1保护细胞免受多种DNA损伤源的影响。同样，缺乏Praja1的细胞对DNA损伤诱导的细胞死亡变得更加敏感，而表达Praja1的大肠杆菌则表现出对DNA损伤的抵抗性。为进一步阐明DNA保护的分子基础，凝胶迁移实验显示，Praja1通过其内在无序区域内的静电相互作用直接结合DNA。进一步的体外损伤实验提示，Praja1在结合DNA后可能诱导结构变化，从而增强DNA修复效率。综合这些结果，为核内Praja1在抵御DNA损伤中的进化新角色提供了见解。
